terra.problem: The text says the king sent to Rahab, not that the order reached her door.
Calling the king's handling of the matter ungentle adds a judgment the text does not establish.
The text does not say the king's men knocked.
It states as fact that searching every house would have led someone to check Rahab's roof.
The comparison does not click: a cookie on a warm window ledge is not a clear image of melting.
The explanation simply repeats the correct answer and the kings' identification from the question, without Papa Dorin's voice.
The text does not say that the relatives Rahab names make up her whole household.
This is a flat restatement of the answer and Rahab's list, with no distinctive voice or added insight.
It gives the king's pursuit of the spies as the reason he is not on Rahab's list. The text gives no such reason.
The text does not say Rahab gave the plan before the spies reached the ground.
The explanation identifies Ai as a city, a Bible fact outside this passage, without a reference.
The description of the wilderness of Zin is outside this passage and has no reference.
It says the spies gave two conditions, overlooking their condition that Rahab not report their mission.
This just restates the question and correct answer in generic language.
The explanation repeats the card almost verbatim without adding insight or Papa Dorin's personality.
She tied the cord when the spies had gone, but 'right then' adds an immediacy the text does not specify.
The pursuers searched all along the road, not everywhere except the spies' hiding place.
The passage does not say the king was still hunting for the spies after the pursuers returned.
